top.title: Binance Suffers Record $6.3 Billion Cryptocurrency Heist Attributed to North Korea
top.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance suffered a massive hack resulting in the theft of approximately $6.3 billion across 10 blockchains in just 20 minutes, with security firms attributing the attack to North Korea-based actors. Binance has temporarily suspended withdrawals and deposits while pledging to cover all user losses.
top.label: REPORTED

sources.title: Binance "temporarily suspended" all deposits and withdrawals as it investigates security issues and works with law enforcement; Binance.US says it's unaffected (George Steer/Financial Times)
Binance pledges to cover all losses from a ~$6.3B hack, potentially the largest crypto theft ever, surpassing the $1.5B Bybit hack in February 2025 (South China Morning Post)
TRM Labs attributes the Binance hack to North Korea-based TraderTraitor, which drained ~$6.36B from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains, mostly in ~20 minutes (Tom Westbrook/Reuters)
